traces.summary: The Blended plan leads with CTV & Streaming (35%) as the premium GBE reach backbone, supported by financial-publisher PMPs (25%), Online Video (25%) and Meta amplification (15%). Budget peaks in February and November around full-year and Q3 results, the strategy update, ADIPEC and COP31.

findings.title: CTV carries the equity story
findings.detail: CTV & Streaming holds the largest share because the7stars campaign history shows it as bp's strongest driver of GBE completed views and view-through.

findings.title: Phasing follows the financial calendar
findings.detail: February and November carry 11% of budget each, matching full-year results and the strategy update, and Q3 results alongside ADIPEC and COP31.

findings.title: Engagement target not cleared
findings.detail: Forecast GBE engagements sit below the 141,667 brief target, although cost per engagement clears the £1.55 ceiling.

traces.summary: The plan balances and every allocation is sourced, but GBE audience sizing and Meta match quality rest on placeholders until IPSOS IGI is connected, and results dates are illustrative.

findings.title: IPSOS IGI not connected
findings.detail: GBE reach and Meta match quality cannot be validated until the IPSOS IGI S3 integration is live.

findings.title: Results dates are illustrative
findings.detail: Quiet periods and results weeks must be confirmed against bp's published financial calendar before sign-off.

findings.title: Cap Meta until validated
findings.detail: Hold Meta at its 15% blended share rather than scaling it, until GBE match quality is confirmed.

traces.summary: Three decisions would most improve this plan before sign-off.

findings.title: How long is the quiet period?
findings.detail: bp Corporate Comms to confirm how many days before each results announcement investor-facing creative must pause.

findings.title: Is engagement the right primary KPI?
findings.detail: Confirm whether the plan should optimise GBE engagements, view-through or verified GBE reach.

findings.title: Plan US conferences now?
findings.detail: Decide whether CERAWeek should carry UK budget now or wait for the US data pipeline.
